methodology.identity: Literal provider/product and model ID, or an explicitly declared upstreamModelId. No vendor-leaf joins across regional, subscription or hosted routes.
methodology.coverage: Complete registry, complete reviewed metadata inventory, complete captured models.dev catalogs, and active/auxiliary/voice lifecycle inventory. Exact-match coverage is distinct from verification.
methodology.limits: Context, independent maximum input and maximum output are separate quantities. No rounding to 1M, subtraction to invent input limits, or transfer of SDK/batch/continuation limits to direct REST.
methodology.pricing: Compare published input, output, cache-read, cache-write and context-tier fields. Classify currencies, subscription references, media units, promotions and primary-source overrides before interpreting numeric differences.
methodology.lifecycle: Absence is not retirement. Scheduled retirement, earliest possible shutdown, account eligibility and compatibility aliases remain distinct.
methodology.timestampQualification: The environment and HTTP Date headers reported October 18 although the requested session date was October 19. Actual timestamps are preserved.
